description:
Why: since fz-sc8.234 quoted metadata is a keyword list. QuotedSourceCursor::meta_value (src/compiler2/source.rs) answers one key by calling meta_entries, which copies every entry into a Vec and a tuple_items Vec per entry, then searches it. Census at b49c80bb7 on the OptionParser probe: about 164k of 1,024k allocations at source.rs:798/:895.

What: meta_value walks the keyword list and returns at the first matching key; meta_entries is built from the same iterator. Entries are checked as they are reached, so a malformed entry after the match is not reported by a lookup (user-approved: stop at the match).

Signal: spike measured 1,024,243 -> 861,458 allocations; program output and canonical backend dump identical. Full gate green, no pin moves.
title: A metadata lookup stops at the entry it asks for
